finding: Snapshot restoration decoded and reserialized original checkpoint attributes without requiring the canonical bytes demanded by the runtime opener. Whitespace or a conflicting duplicate key could therefore be refused at original startup yet normalized into a restored owner.

production_change.behavior: Require original checkpoint bytes to equal their canonical encoding before any physical checkpoint derivation. Preserve original rejected bytes and return the existing identity class.
adjacent_callers_reviewed: mainnet successor local and nonce member adapters
miner fleet recovery and provider claim snapshots

regression.positive_controls: Actual fresh preparation, canonical empty and committed runtime restart, public export and restore, then original history readback under both exclusive and complete-union profiles.
regression.negative_controls: Whitespace and conflicting duplicate-schema originals fail both actual runtime admission and public restore planning; target members remain absent and held/archive original attribute bytes remain unchanged.
regression.proposed_causal_control: Remove only the canonical comparison in PlanRestore. The malformed-original public restore controls must then fail while their runtime refusals remain in place.
regression.execution: Not compiled or executed by the author. Independent normal, race and causal-control qualification remains pending.
